Sachin Tendulkar is a legendary former Indian cricketer widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen of all time. Often referred to as the God of Cricket, he holds numerous world records, including being the leading run scorer in both Test and One Day International cricket and the only player to score one hundred international centuries. Throughout his illustrious career, which began when he was sixteen, he became a global icon and was awarded the Bharat Ratna, which is the highest civilian honor in India.
